data.name: SettingsFirstRunHint
data.value: Windows melindungi Gambar, Dokumen, Desktop, dan Video dari aplikasi yang tidak dikenalnya, jadi folder milik Anda sendiri adalah pilihan yang aman. Shotwin memastikan folder itu bisa dipakai sebelum menggunakannya.
data.comment: The folder question asked on the first capture: why a folder of your own is suggested. Pictures, Documents, Desktop and Videos are Windows folder names.

data.name: SettingsFirstRunPickFolder
data.value: Pilih sebuah folder, atau pakai bawaan.
data.comment: The folder question asked on the first capture, when the box was left empty.

data.name: SettingsFirstRunProtected
data.value: Windows tidak mengizinkan Shotwin menulis di sana — folder itu dilindungi Akses folder terkontrol. Pilih yang lain, atau pakai bawaan.
data.comment: The folder question asked on the first capture, when the chosen folder is protected. Controlled Folder Access is a Windows feature name.

data.name: SettingsFirstRunSubtitle
data.value: Tangkapan pertama Anda sudah siap. Pilih folder sekarang dan folder itu dipakai seterusnya — Anda bisa menggantinya nanti di Pengaturan.
data.comment: The folder question asked on the first capture, the line under its heading.

data.name: SettingsFirstRunTitle
data.value: Di mana Shotwin menyimpan tangkapan layar Anda?
data.comment: Heading of the folder question asked on the first capture.

data.name: SettingsFirstRunUnwritable
data.value: Shotwin tidak bisa menulis di sana. Periksa jalurnya, atau pakai bawaan.
data.comment: The folder question asked on the first capture, when the chosen folder refused a test write.

data.name: SettingsFirstRunUse
data.comment: The folder question asked on the first capture: button that accepts the typed folder.

data.name: SettingsFolder
data.comment: Label over the save folder box, in Settings and in the question asked on the first capture.

data.name: SettingsFolderOpenFailed
data.comment: Settings page, when Windows refused to open the save folder.

data.name: SettingsFolderProtected
data.value: Akses folder terkontrol Windows melindungi folder ini, jadi Shotwin tidak bisa menulis ke sana. Tangkapan masuk ke folder cadangan — tidak ada yang hilang. Izinkan Shotwin di Keamanan Windows jika Anda ingin memakai folder ini.
data.comment: Settings page, under the save folder box when the folder is protected. Controlled Folder Access and Windows Security are Windows feature names.

data.name: SettingsFolderUnwritable
data.value: Shotwin tidak bisa menulis ke folder ini, jadi tangkapan masuk ke folder cadangan. Periksa jalurnya dan pastikan Anda punya izin menulis di sana.
data.comment: Settings page, under the save folder box when a write failed for any other reason.

data.name: SettingsLanguage
data.comment: Settings page, label beside the language list under SYSTEM.

data.name: SettingsLanguageAutomatic
data.comment: Settings page, first entry in the language list: use whatever display language Windows is set to. Every other entry is a language written in its own words and is never translated.

data.name: SettingsNextFile
data.comment: Settings page, a worked example under the file name box. {0} is the name the template produces right now.

data.name: SettingsNotWritten
data.value: Pengaturan Anda tidak bisa dibaca saat Shotwin dijalankan, jadi perubahan ini tidak tersimpan. Mulai ulang Shotwin untuk mencoba lagi.
data.comment: Settings and Shortcuts pages, shown in place of the "Saved." confirmation when the settings file could not be read at startup and the app is refusing to overwrite it with defaults.

data.name: SettingsOpen
data.comment: Settings page, button that opens the save folder in Explorer.

data.name: SettingsOpenEditor
data.comment: Settings page, tick box under AFTER CAPTURE.

data.name: SettingsOverlayHeader
data.comment: Settings page, section heading over the capture overlay options. Upper case in English.

data.name: SettingsPreviewAppears
data.comment: Settings page, label beside the list of corners the preview thumbnail can appear in.

data.name: SettingsPreviewHint
data.value: Pratinjau adalah tempat Anda mengambil tangkapan: klik untuk mengedit, seret ke aplikasi mana pun untuk menjatuhkan PNG-nya, atau pakai tombol di tepi bawahnya. Pratinjau hilang saat Anda kembali ke jendela lain, meninggalkan tangkapan di papan klip siap ditempel. Jika penyimpanan otomatis mati, tangkapan dibuang kecuali Anda menekan Simpan di pratinjau.
data.comment: Settings page, the paragraph explaining the preview thumbnail. PNG is a file format name.

data.name: SettingsSaved
data.comment: Settings page, the confirmation that floats over the bottom of the list after a change is written.

data.name: SettingsSavingHeader
data.comment: Settings page, section heading over the folder and file name options. Upper case in English.

data.name: SettingsSecurityDone
data.value: Selesai. Shotwin sudah bisa menulis ke folder itu.
data.comment: Settings page, after Windows Security accepted the app and the folder now takes writes.

data.name: SettingsSecurityStillBlocked
data.value: Windows menerima perubahannya, tetapi folder itu tetap menolak penulisan.
data.comment: Settings page, after Windows Security accepted the app but the folder still refuses writes.

data.name: SettingsShowCoordinates
data.comment: Settings page, tick box under OVERLAY.

data.name: SettingsShowPreview
data.comment: Settings page, tick box under AFTER CAPTURE.

data.name: SettingsSnapWindows
data.value: Rekatkan ke jendela di bawah kursor
data.comment: Settings page, tick box under OVERLAY.

data.name: SettingsStartupHint
data.value: Langsung mulai di area notifikasi tanpa jendela.
data.comment: Settings page, under the start-at-login tick box.

data.name: SettingsStartupRefused
data.value: Windows menolak perubahan mulai saat masuk.
data.comment: Settings page, when the registry entry for starting at login could not be written.

data.name: SettingsStartWithWindows
data.comment: Settings page, tick box under SYSTEM.

data.name: SettingsSubtitle
data.comment: Settings page, the line under its heading.

data.name: SettingsSystemHeader
data.comment: Settings page, section heading over the language and start-at-login options. Upper case in English.

data.name: SettingsTitle
data.comment: Settings page, its heading.

data.name: SettingsWaitingForAdmin
data.comment: Settings page, while the Windows elevation prompt is on screen.

data.name: ShortcutsCaptureArea
data.comment: Shortcuts page, name of the area capture action. Also names it in the messages about shortcuts Windows refused.

data.name: ShortcutsCaptureAreaDetail
data.comment: Shortcuts page, what the area capture shortcut does.

data.name: ShortcutsCaptureScreen
data.comment: Shortcuts page, name of the whole-screen capture action.

data.name: ShortcutsCaptureScreenDetail
data.comment: Shortcuts page, what the screen capture shortcut does.

data.name: ShortcutsClash
data.value: Kombinasi itu sudah dipakai tindakan lain.
data.comment: Shortcuts page, when the recorded combination is already bound to a different Shotwin action.

data.name: ShortcutsEditorCommands
data.value: Ctrl+C salin · Ctrl+S simpan · Ctrl+Shift+S simpan sebagai · Ctrl+P sematkan · Ctrl+Z urungkan · Ctrl+roda zoom · Ctrl+0 paskan · Delete hapus · Esc tutup
data.comment: Shortcuts page, the editor's command keys. Translate only the word after each key name; the key names themselves stay as they are.

data.name: ShortcutsEditorHeader
data.comment: Shortcuts page, heading over the editor's own keys. Upper case in English.

data.name: ShortcutsEditorTools
data.value: V pilih · A panah · R persegi panjang · O elips · L garis · P pena · H stabilo · T teks · S nomor langkah · B pikselasi · Shift+B buramkan
data.comment: Shortcuts page, the editor's tool keys. Translate only the words after each key name; the letters themselves are fixed keys and stay as they are.

data.name: ShortcutsGrabText
data.comment: Shortcuts page, name of the text recognition action.

data.name: ShortcutsGrabTextDetail
data.value: Membaca sebuah area dan menyalin teksnya
data.comment: Shortcuts page, what the text shortcut does.

data.name: ShortcutsNotSet
data.comment: Shown in place of a key combination when an action has none bound.

data.name: ShortcutsPickColour
data.comment: Shortcuts page, name of the colour picker action.

data.name: ShortcutsPickColourDetail
data.value: Lup di atas layar; sekali klik menyalin nilainya
data.comment: Shortcuts page, what the colour shortcut does. A loupe is a magnifying lens.

data.name: ShortcutsPressCombination
data.comment: Shortcuts page, shown in a box that is waiting for the keys to be pressed.

data.name: ShortcutsRefused
data.value: Windows tidak memberikan ini ke Shotwin: {0}. Aplikasi lain sudah memilikinya.
data.comment: Shortcuts page, when Windows refused to register a combination. {0} is a comma-separated list of action names.

data.name: ShortcutsSaved
data.comment: Shortcuts page, the confirmation after a new combination is written.

data.name: ShortcutsScrolling
data.comment: Shortcuts page, name of the scrolling capture action.

data.name: ShortcutsScrollingDetail
data.comment: Shortcuts page, what the scrolling shortcut does.

data.name: ShortcutsSubtitle
data.value: Klik sebuah pintasan, lalu tekan kombinasi yang Anda mau. Esc membatalkan.
data.comment: Shortcuts page, the line under its heading. Esc is a key name.

data.name: ShortcutsTitle
data.comment: Shortcuts page, its heading.

data.name: TrayCaptureArea
data.comment: Notification area menu item that opens the area overlay.

data.name: TrayCaptureScreen
data.comment: Notification area menu item that grabs the monitor the cursor is on.

data.name: TrayColourCopied
data.comment: Notification after the colour picker. {0} is the colour value, for example #1B1B1F.

data.name: TrayCrash
data.comment: Notification after an error the app recovered from. {0} is the message from Windows, {1} is the path of the log file. Neither is translated.

data.name: TrayFileUnreadable
data.comment: Notification when a saved shot could not be decoded to reopen it.

data.name: TrayGrabText
data.comment: Notification area menu item that reads the text out of a region.

data.name: TrayHotkeyConflicts
data.value: Aplikasi lain sudah memiliki pintasan ini: {0}. Ubah di halaman Pintasan.
data.comment: Notification at startup when Windows refused a shortcut. {0} is a comma-separated list of action names. Shortcuts is the name of a page in the app.

data.name: TrayNoText
data.value: Tidak ada teks di area itu.
data.comment: Notification when text recognition ran on a captured region and read nothing.

data.name: TrayOpen
data.comment: Notification area menu item that shows the main window.

data.name: TrayPickColour
data.comment: Notification area menu item that opens the colour loupe.

data.name: TrayQuit
data.comment: Notification area menu item that ends the app.

data.name: TrayRecent
data.comment: Notification area menu item that opens the gallery of saved shots.

data.name: TraySaveFailed
data.comment: Notification when automatic saving failed. {0} is the reason, from ErrorSaveBlocked or from Windows.

data.name: TrayScrollingCapture
data.comment: Notification area menu item that starts a scrolling capture.

data.name: TraySettings
data.comment: Notification area menu item that opens the settings page.

data.name: VideoCaption
data.comment: Video editor window caption. {0} is the file name.

data.name: VideoClipboardBusy
data.value: Papan klip sedang sibuk. Coba lagi.
data.comment: Shown when another app holds the clipboard.

data.name: VideoCopied
data.comment: Shown after the file is put on the clipboard.

data.name: VideoCopy
data.comment: Video editor button that copies the file itself.

data.name: VideoCut
data.comment: Video editor button that drops a stretch of the recording out of the middle.

data.name: VideoCutCount_One
data.comment: How many stretches are being dropped. {0} is the number, here one.

data.name: VideoCutCount_Many
data.comment: How many stretches are being dropped. {0} is the number, two or more.

data.name: VideoCutRemove
data.comment: Tooltip on the small cross that undoes one cut.

data.name: VideoExplorerFailed
data.comment: Shown when revealing the file in Explorer fails.

data.name: VideoHintDrawPiece
data.value: Seret di garis waktu untuk potongan lain
data.comment: Hint under the video editor's timeline, saying how to add a second kept piece of a recording.

data.name: VideoQualitySharper
data.value: Gambar lebih tajam, frame lebih sedikit
data.comment: Tooltip on the video editor button that trades playback smoothness for detail.

data.name: VideoQualitySmoother
data.value: Gambar lebih mulus, detail lebih sedikit
data.comment: Tooltip on the video editor button that trades detail for playback smoothness.

data.name: VideoNothingLeft
data.value: Setelah pemotongan tidak ada yang tersisa untuk disimpan.
data.comment: Shown when every part of the recording has been cut away.

data.name: VideoPause
data.comment: Video editor transport button.

data.name: VideoPlay
data.comment: Video editor transport button.

data.name: VideoPosition
data.comment: Video editor position readout: current time over total, both m:ss.

data.name: VideoSave
data.comment: Video editor button that exports the selected span as a new file.

data.name: VideoSaveFailed
data.comment: Shown when the trim export fails. {0} is the reason.

data.name: VideoSaved
data.comment: Shown after a trimmed copy is written. {0} is the file name.

data.name: VideoSaving
data.comment: Video editor progress while the trimmed copy is written. {0} is percent.

data.name: VideoShowInFolder
data.comment: Video editor button that reveals the file in Explorer.

data.name: VideoSpanTooShort
data.value: Pilih rentang yang lebih panjang untuk disimpan.
data.comment: Shown when the trim handles are too close together.

data.name: VideoTrimSpan
data.comment: Video editor readout of the selected span, both m:ss.

data.name: VideoUnreadable
data.comment: Shown when the video file will not load.

data.name: VideoCardDetail
data.comment: Detail line on a recording's card in Recent: {0} is the date and size, {1} is how long it runs.
